assessments.reason: Payment labels and checkout recovery UI change; select the representative order-history visual group and verify failure/label surfaces directly outside the screenshot matrix.
assessments.consumers: Payment state contracts and preparation/restart recovery flow into persisted Order truth displayed by customer order history, so select its orders visual group. Public new/restart/resume responses normalize through useOrder and cartStore into /checkout/fail; scoped desktop/mobile browser cases cover cart/quote/recovery/unknown errors, no-ID retry cleanup, unknown-ID navigation, and successful/rejected known cancellation without duplicate requests. getPaymentStatusById feeds transaction options and the repaired /dashboard/customers/customer-001 RecentTransactions panel and /order-summary/ord-1 tracking dialog. Direct browser tests cover actual known/unknown labels and reject numeric-string/array statuses with neutral tracking indicators; these consumers are outside the visual matrix and are not proved by the orders screenshot. Catalog/product rendering, cart line totals, shared layouts/styles, dependencies and provider activation are unchanged; home/search/product/cart screenshots do not exercise these contract-only effects. Corrupt stored states retain conservative recovery and refuse provider/fulfillment side effects; PostgreSQL tests prove rollback and refusal. No storefront-wide screenshot matrix is needed.
